name: Why are my slow drains making gurgling noises?

mainEntity.name: Why are my slow drains making gurgling noises?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gurgling noises from slow drains often indicate a blockage that's restricting airflow in your plumbing system. When water tries to pass a clog, air gets trapped and then released, creating a gurgling sound. If these noises occur in multiple fixtures or in conjunction with slow drainage throughout your house, it's a strong sign of a significant obstruction in your main sewer line. This requires professional attention to clear the blockage and restore proper drainage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gurgling noises from slow drains mean a blockage is trapping air in your pipes. If it's widespread, it points to a main sewer line clog that needs professional clearing.
